reason: These journalctl arguments must match the pinned rule in deploy/sudoers-trading exactly (-n 200 --no-pager). sudo -n refuses anything else, and the old rule's trailing * let arbitrary extra journalctl arguments run as root.
author: Blueangelman36
snippet:
ok, output = run_cmd(
    ["sudo", "-n", "journalctl", "-u", f"{UNIT_PREFIX}{name}.service",
     "-n", "200",  # asof:journal-lines
     "--no-pager"], timeout=30)
